verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP interface explicitly lets an AI agent query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping 'all with your approval' (kick-docs-16), and every transaction (including AI-driven ones) generates a real double-entry journal entry logged in the Activity audit trail under the relevant Kick agent (kick-supp-journal-entries, kick-supp-audit-trail). However, there is no documented feature for an agent to 'post' entries into a distinct accountant-facing review queue — the closest analogues are low-confidence categorization being left for manual review (kick-supp-categorization) and accountants locking periods after review (kick-supp-locks), neither of which is a dedicated journal-entry review queue tied to agent-drafted entries. Missing for 10: explicit agent-drafted journal-entry review/approval queue, confirmation that MCP write actions create pending (not auto-posted) entries, and accountant-specific approval workflow for AI-generated entries.
